# San Marino

Separate external-country boundary, not an Italian municipality or ISTAT dataset.

- ISO 3166: SM / SMR. `com_istat_code: SMR` is a legacy application geometry-key property, explicitly not an ISTAT code; `istat_code` is null.
- Source: geoBoundaries, OpenStreetMap contributors and Wambacher; boundary represented year 2017, source metadata and immutable download URL retained in san-marino-source.json.
- License: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL). Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/ . The country file remains separate from ISTAT data.
- Geometry is retained from the source in WGS84. Properties are adapted for the application. No postal boundaries or official Italian municipality code are inferred.
- In meteo3 the original territory rule for Repubblica di San Marino is linked to this state-wide polygon without rewriting the source database.
